content:
**Good Doggy** is an Endurance-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Eating dog food is now three times as beneficial.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Eating dog food is now three times as beneficial. | 00393F5B | 

For the cost of one perk card slot, the healing benefits of canned dog food exceed the craftable healing salve (at base HP of 250) using rank 3 of the perk First Aid, while also restoring significant hunger (30%). It works extremely well with the Cola Nut or Bloodsucker perks.
